title: Grateful for Small Things
paragraphs: After a long day of work, Hana comes home exhausted and slightly annoyed about a missed promotion. She sits on her balcony and looks at the simple things around her: a warm meal, a working home, and good health.

She reminds herself that everything she has, big or small, comes from Allah alone. This thought does not erase her disappointment, but it puts it into a calmer perspective before she goes to sleep that night.

For a moment, she compares her situation to a friend recovering from illness, and realizes how easily she overlooked her own good health while focusing only on the promotion she did not receive this year.
The next morning, Hana wakes up with a clearer mind. She realizes that recognizing Allah as the source of every blessing keeps her grounded, whether her week goes exactly as planned or not at all.
